title: A criterion for an effective discretization of a continuous Schrödinger spectrum using a pseudostate basis
summary: We consider a Hamiltonian $\hat H$ with a (partially) continuous spectrum and examine the zero-overlap condition which involves the projection onto exact continuum eigenstates of a set of pseudostates obtained from the diagonalization of $\hat H$ in a finite basis of square-integrable functions. For each projected pseudostate the condition implies the occurrence of zeros at all energies that correspond to the pseudo-continuum matrix eigenvalues, except for the eigenenergy associated with that pseudostate.
